name: Apart Florida, Fam. Tschallener
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Apart Florida, Fam. Tschallener in **Tirol** operates as an apartment hotel. The location is peaceful and offers views of the surrounding mountains. The accommodation features apartments with a kitchenette, allowing for self-catering. Upon request, a breakfast service is provided. The property includes a sauna area. Managed by the Tschallener family, it creates a personal atmosphere. In the area, there are hiking and cycling trails as well as winter sports opportunities available. This accommodation is ideal for guests who value independence and a quiet setting.
